parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 8 and using all 11 shards dropped my val_bpb from 0.899 to 0.847. My latest run even reached 0.8399. I'll now try reducing the learning rate slightly to 0.03 to see if more stable, smaller updates help convergence at this depth.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to check if a lower learning rate provides better convergence stability for the depth-8 configuration.
